source_note: R-06 keyword source for the asymmetric fraud rule. Case-insensitive substring match on normalised text (zero-width removed, whitespace collapsed). Deliberately explicit phrases only: a match can only ADD an ID_FRAUD_SUSPECTED escalation, never remove one, so false positives cost reviewer time, not consumer harm. Paraphrases are left to the LLM signal. Must be replaced by a reviewed list before any non-synthetic run (R-35). v0.2.0 (2026-11-07, integrator): added common account-denial phrasings after an error analysis of 2 missed fraud letters in v1_seed20261107_n200; that set is therefore no longer unseen for fraud routing. Holdout measurement uses a fresh seed.
